text:
Category: Gaming
Name: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather
resources. First you have to find out which resources you want. Up to
10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed
than others. Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to
gather other resources. (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).

After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming. Sometimes, 
random natural disasters strike and set your bot back. Whenever some milestones
are reached, you are notified.

During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at
all times).

After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends
and/or send them materials.

ecarts.quote: After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
ecarts.explanation:
L'écart entre le processus observé et l'exigence du texte source provient du fait que l'activité "final step" n'est pas précédée de l'activité "choose materials to send" dans le processus observé.

La citation fournie "After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials." montre qu'une condition est exigée avant l'activité "choose materials to send", mais elle ne décrit pas ce que cette condition signifie précisément.

Dans le processus observé, les deux activités existent bien, mais rien ne garantit que "final step" ait eu lieu avant "choose materials to send".
